parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first(); const bin=x.binary||{}; const k=Object.keys(bin).find(k=>bin[k].mimeType==='application/pdf'||(bin[k].fileName||'').toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf'));if(!k) return [{json:{valid:false,message:'Upload multipart/form-data PDF using field file; binary PDF required'}}];return [{json:{valid:true,upload_filename:bin[k].fileName||'invoice.pdf'},binary:{data:bin[k]}}];

const d=$input.first().json;const t=String(d.text||d.data||'');const pick=(re)=>{const m=t.match(re);return m?m[1].trim():''};const money=s=>Number(String(s||'0').replace(/,/g,''));const invoice_number=pick(/Invoice\s*(?:Number|No\.?)[\s:]*(INV[- ]?\d{4,10}(?:[- ]?\d{2,10})?|[A-Z]{2,4}[- ]?\d{4,8})/i);const po_number=pick(/PO\s*(?:Reference|Number|No\.?)[\s:]*((?:PO-?)\d{5,8})/i);const tax_identifier=pick(/(?:GSTIN\s*\/\s*Tax ID|GSTIN|Tax ID|VAT ID)\s*:\s*([A-Z0-9]{8,20})/i);const vendor_name=pick(/Vendor\s*Name\s*:\s*([^\r\n]+)/i)||pick(/^\s*([A-Z][A-Z &.]{5,})\s*$/m);const date_raw=pick(/Invoice\s*Date\s*:\s*(\d{1,2}[/-]\d{1,2}[/-]\d{4}|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})/i);let invoice_date=date_raw;if(/^\d{2}[/-]\d{2}[/-]\d{4}$/.test(date_raw)){const p=date_raw.split(/[/-]/);invoice_date=`${p[2]}-${p[1]}-${p[0]}`;}const invoiced_subtotal=money(pick(/SUBTOTAL\s*AMOUNT\s*:\s*([\d,.]+)/i));const invoiced_tax=money(pick(/(?:GST\s*TAX(?:\s*\(\d+%\))?|TAX\s*AMOUNT)\s*:\s*([\d,.]+)/i));const invoiced_total=money(pick(/INVOICE\s*TOTAL\s*:\s*([\d,.]+)/i));const items=[];for(const line of t.split(/\r?\n/)){const m=line.match(/^\s*\d+\.\s+(.+?)\s+Qty:\s*(\d+)\s+Unit\s*Price:\s*([\d,.]+)\s+Total:\s*([\d,.]+)/i);if(m)items.push({description:m[1].trim(),quantity:Number(m[2]),unit_price:money(m[3]),amount:money(m[4])});}const item_sum=items.reduce((s,a)=>s+a.amount,0);const checksum_variance=Math.round(Math.abs(invoiced_subtotal+invoiced_tax-invoiced_total)*100)/100;const line_variance=Math.round(Math.abs(item_sum-invoiced_subtotal)*100)/100;const valid=!!invoice_number&&!!po_number&&!!vendor_name&&!!tax_identifier&&!!invoice_date&&invoiced_total>0&&items.length>0&&checksum_variance<=0.05&&line_variance<=0.05;return [{json:{invoice_number,normalized_invoice_number:invoice_number.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,''),po_number:po_number.toUpperCase(),tax_identifier,vendor_name,invoice_date,invoiced_subtotal,invoiced_tax,invoiced_total,items,item_sum,checksum_variance,line_variance,valid,validation_error:valid?'':'Missing invoice fields, line items or invalid subtotal/tax/total checksum',source_text:t.slice(0,12000)}}];

parameters.query: SELECT 'vendor' AS record_type,v.vendor_id,v.legal_name,v.tax_identifier,v.is_active,NULL::text AS po_number,NULL::text AS po_vendor_id,NULL::numeric AS po_total,NULL::integer AS qty_received,NULL::integer AS gr_count,NULL::text AS invoice_number FROM public.vendors v UNION ALL SELECT 'po',NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,p.po_number,p.vendor_id,p.total_amount,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(g.quantity_received)::integer FROM public.goods_receipts g WHERE g.po_number=p.po_number AND g.inspection_passed),0),COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM public.goods_receipts g WHERE g.po_number=p.po_number AND g.inspection_passed),0),NULL FROM public.purchase_orders p WHERE p.po_number=$1 UNION ALL SELECT 'invoice',i.vendor_id,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,i.invoice_number FROM public.invoices i WHERE i.po_number=$1;

parameters.jsCode: const inv=$('05 Read invoice fields').first().json;const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json);const norm=s=>String(s||'').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9]/g,'');const lev=(a,b)=>{const v=Array.from({length:b.length+1},(_,i)=>i);for(let i=1;i<=a.length;i++){let prev=v[0];v[0]=i;for(let j=1;j<=b.length;j++){const old=v[j];v[j]=Math.min(v[j]+1,v[j-1]+1,prev+(a[i-1]===b[j-1]?0:1));prev=old;}}return v[b.length]};const clean=s=>String(s||'').toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z0-9 ]/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();let best=null,score=0;for(const v of rows.filter(r=>r.record_type==='vendor'&&r.is_active)){const a=clean(inv.vendor_name),b=clean(v.legal_name);const s=100*(1-lev(a,b)/Math.max(a.length,b.length,1));if(s>score){score=s;best=v;}}const po=rows.find(r=>r.record_type==='po');const duplicate=!!best&&rows.some(r=>r.record_type==='invoice'&&r.vendor_id===best.vendor_id&&norm(r.invoice_number)===norm(inv.invoice_number));const qty=inv.items.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.quantity,0);const amountDiff=Math.abs(inv.invoiced_total-Number(po?.po_total||0));let reason='MATCH_OK';if(!best||score<80||norm(best.tax_identifier)!==norm(inv.tax_identifier))reason='UNKNOWN_VENDOR';else if(duplicate)reason='DUPLICATE_INVOICE';else if(!po||po.po_vendor_id!==best.vendor_id)reason='PO_NOT_FOUND_OR_WRONG_VENDOR';else if(Number(po.gr_count)<1)reason='GOODS_RECEIPT_MISSING';else if(Number(po.qty_received)<qty)reason='QUANTITY_DISCREPANCY';else if(amountDiff>Number(po.po_total)*0.01)reason='AMOUNT_DISCREPANCY';return [{json:{...inv,vendor_id:best?.vendor_id||null,vendor_similarity:Number(score.toFixed(1)),po_total:Number(po?.po_total||0),quantity_received:Number(po?.qty_received||0),quantity_invoiced:qty,computed_variance:Number(amountDiff.toFixed(2)),status:reason,ready_for_approval:reason==='MATCH_OK'}}];
